author: Reirilain
quote: Thirteen years, billions of dollars, and a 99 from the press — for a game locked at 30 fps, dropping to 15 on a base PS5, where the epic heists are separated by grilling burgers, mini golf and walking the dog. The world looks incredible. So does a screensaver. As a Zelda and Witcher 3 player, I will happily keep my freedom and my frame rate.

author: Reirilain
quote: best game in 2026 ：A timeless masterpiece, beautifully rebuilt. The remake keeps everything that made the original legendary — the dungeons, the music, the sense of adventure — while the modern visuals and controls make it feel like a brand new game. Playing it again after all these years reminded me why Ocarina of Time shaped so many games that came after it. The best game of 2026, and still one of the greatest games ever made.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
